annotations.title: Pay a batch analysis charge and build

description: Step 2 of a payout_batch with checks, on Solana or EVM. After signing and sending payout_batch's charge.transaction, hand its signature or hash here with the loteId and payer. The server verifies the charge on-chain, runs the paid analysis on EVERY destination, EXCLUDES any wallet that is blocked or over the payer's risk threshold (it receives nothing, its money never moved), and returns { transactions[], evm?, approved[] (each with its scan result), rejected[] (wallet, reason) }. On Solana, sign each transactions[i].transaction (prepare_signing, POST to /v1/svm/execute) and call payout_report_payment with that signature and its invoiceIds. On EVM, sign evm.steps IN ORDER (approve, then pay the IBBs contract) and call payout_report_payment with the pay transaction hash and evm.invoiceIds. Idempotent with the same charge signature (re-returns the built batch, without the wallets already paid, listed in alreadyPaid). The charge hash goes only here, never to payout_report_payment. Errors: batch_charge_not_found, invalid_tx_hash, analysis_payment_pending (409, the network has not confirmed the charge yet, send the signature again shortly), analysis_payment_rejected (the transaction does not pay this charge; details.reason charge_not_tied when it is not the transaction payout_batch built: do not pay again, prove the wallet with destination_challenge (receiver = details.feeWallet, chargeId = the loteId, chargeTxHash = that hash), then destination_authorize, and call this again), tx_already_used.

payer.description: The wallet that paid the charge (base58 on Solana, 0x on EVM).

txHash.description: The Solana signature or EVM transaction hash of the charge payment. Omit only to rebuild a fully-reused batch (website session only).

name: payout_charge
